title: PM Rahman calls for continued US investment in Bangladesh
content:
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman recently called for continued US investment in Bangladesh, particularly in warehousing, soybean, cotton, wheat and IT sectors. 
He said this while meeting US President's Special Envoy for South and Central Asia Sergio Gor in Dhaka. 
Both also exchanged views on investment opportunities through the US International Development Finance Corporation.

title: HCM City working on developing Vietnam’s energy, industrial hub
content:
Vietnam’s Ho Chi Minh City is working on developing a multi-pole national energy and industrial hub to secure regional energy supplies and accelerate green transition. 
Crucial for energy security, the hub will operate as a multi-pole ecosystem rather than a single concentrated site. 
Its draft outline identifies three industrial poles linked with research institutes, universities and the financial sector.

title: India-China cross-border trade through Shipki La resumes after 6 years
content:
Cross-border trade through Shipki La, the ancient silk route linking India with Tibet, resumed yesterday after six years. 
Himanchal Pradesh revenue and horticulture minister Jagat Singh Negi flagged off the first batch of 16 traders. 
Goods exchange would take place via a barter system and the traders would have to return within 72 hours. 
Seventy two Indian items and 30 Chinese items can be bartered.

title: MSP for seed cotton raised by 7% for cotton season 2026-27 in India
content:
The Cotton Corporation of India undertook one of the largest minimum support price (MSP) procurement operations in its history by procuring over 52.2 million quintals of cotton seeds through nearly 2.4 million farmer transactions during cotton season 2025-26, according to Minister of Textiles Giriraj Singh. 
The MSP for seed cotton has been increased by about 7 per cent for cotton season 2026-27, he said.
